This folder's licence notice was written by the Duskhold project; the model file itself
carries no embedded licence text.

Source
  Poly Pizza model page : https://poly.pizza/m/qvTrSG9pZF
  Direct download       : https://static.poly.pizza/d37dbc87-ca61-4b2c-a2da-d2f0c4240bef.glb
  Original pack         : "Ultimate Animated Animals" by Quaternius (2021)
                          https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html
  Retrieved             : 2026-09-29

Licence evidence (checked 2026-09-29)
  Poly Pizza page states: "Public Domain (CC0)" and links
    https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
  The 2021 pack page on quaternius.com states: "License CC0".
  Quaternius's licence page (https://quaternius.com/license.html) now shows the
  "Quaternius Asset License (QAL) v1.0", last updated 8/28/2026. It forbids redistributing
  "the Assets themselves ... as a standalone asset" and says "the version in effect at the
  time you obtained the Assets governs your use of them". The QAL v1.0 (last updated
  8/28/2026) predates the 2026-09-29 retrieval, so that clause does not by itself favour
  CC0. The model is recorded here as CC0-1.0 because the Poly Pizza page and the author's
  2021 pack page above both stated CC0 when it was retrieved, and an earlier CC0 dedication
  is irrevocable. It is used inside a game and is not redistributed as a standalone asset.

Licence re-check (2026-10-01)
  The 2021 pack page https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html still
  states "License: CC0" and links https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
  The Poly Pizza page https://poly.pizza/m/qvTrSG9pZF still states "Public Domain (CC0)".
  The QAL v1.0 page (last updated 8/28/2026) says nothing about assets earlier released
  under CC0.

Decision (2026-10-01)
  The owner keeps this model. The decision rests on the author's own 2021 pack page and the
  Poly Pizza page both stating CC0 when the model was retrieved (checked 2026-09-29,
  re-checked 2026-10-01), and on an earlier CC0 dedication being irrevocable; it does not
  rest on the QAL "time you obtained" clause. The owner accepts the residual licence risk
  (2026-10-01). It stays recorded as CC0-1.0 in assets/attribution.json and ASSETS.md.
